preview.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "_col_0" FROM (SELECT "b"."birth_date", "b"."brand", "b"."company_name", "b"."country", "b"."email", "b"."full_name", "b"."gender", "b"."inbound_flight_no", "b"."inbound_flight_time", "b"."invitation_requirement", "b"."invitation_status_raw", "b"."job_title", "b"."market_contact", "b"."media_account", "b"."optional_brand", "b"."outbound_flight_no", "b"."outbound_flight_time", "b"."passport_no", "b"."person_type", "b"."regional_contact", "b"."registration_id", "b"."reporting_unit", "b"."vip_mark", "b"."visa_status", "b"."visa_status_raw" FROM main."registrations" AS b WHERE b.snapshot_id = :_snapshot) AS registrations WHERE "registrations"."brand" = 'CHERY') AS _result LIMIT :_row_cap
